categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in high-end electronic materials, including copper clad laminates (CCL), prepregs (PP), and multilayer laminates (MLB) used in printed circuit boards (PCBs). It focuses on advanced materials for AI servers, high-speed computing, electric vehicles, data centers, and automotive electronics. The company also develops flexible printed circuit boards (FPC) for consumer electronics and automotive applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced resin formulation and coating technologies to produce high-frequency, low-loss, high-heat resistant, and environmentally friendly electronic-grade substrate materials. Manufacturing processes include multilayer lamination, copper foil bonding, and precision quality control systems. It also employs smart manufacturing technologies to enhance production efficiency and cost control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global PCB manufacturers and end-users in AI computing, data centers, electric vehicles, automotive electronics, 5G/6G communications, and semiconductor packaging industries. The company serves major international clients in Asia, Europe, and North America, focusing on high-performance and niche market segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities and sales offices in Taiwan, China (Dongguan, Wuxi, Guangzhou, Jiangxi), and Thailand, with expanding presence in Southeast Asia to mitigate geopolitical risks. Its sales are predominantly in Asia, with growing markets in Europe and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the PCB supply chain, producing key electronic materials such as copper clad laminates and prepregs that are essential inputs for PCB manufacturers. It also extends capabilities into semiconductor packaging materials, positioning itself as a critical materials supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding high-frequency, low-dielectric constant, and high-reliability materials for AI servers, electric vehicles, and 5G/6G infrastructure. The company emphasizes sustainable development with green manufacturing, carbon footprint reduction, and collaboration with supply chain partners. R&D focuses on ultra-low loss materials, high-density interconnects, flexible substrates, and automotive-grade materials for ADAS and battery applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of electronic materials including copper clad laminates, prepregs, and multilayer laminates. The company also earns income from strategic investments and licensing related to its advanced materials technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in high-end PCB materials with a top market share (16%) in advanced specialty substrates. It competes with major suppliers from the US, Japan, Korea, China, and Taiwan. Its competitive advantages include advanced technology, comprehensive product lines, strong customer relationships, and geographic diversification.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenues of approximately NT$29.4 billion in the latest fiscal year, reflecting a 17.14% year-over-year growth. Operating profit and net income also increased significantly, driven by market demand recovery and improved capacity utilization. The company continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, with a stable financial position and growing shareholder equity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-performance, environmentally friendly electronic materials with superior quality, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. It differentiates through advanced resin and coating technologies, strong R&D capabilities, and tailored solutions for emerging applications such as AI computing, electric vehicles, and 5G communications. Its commitment to sustainability and supply chain resilience further enhances its competitive positioning.
